gloss: dead battery; battery drained; out of power

definitions.gloss: dead battery; battery drained; out of power
definitions.explanation: The state of a battery being completely depleted, causing a device to stop functioning.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{電池切|でんちぎ}れになった。
{電池切|でんちぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't contact you because my battery was dead.

examples.japanese: {電池切|でんちぎ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦モバイルバッテリー→モバイルバッテリー：07553_mobairubatterii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧。
examples.english: I carry a portable charger to prevent my battery from dying.

notes:
{電池切|でんちぎ}れ describes the state of a battery being completely drained. Extremely common in daily life with smartphones and other devices.

FORMS:
⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧ (battery) + {切|き}れ (running out, from ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {電池切|でんちぎ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the battery dies
- {電池切|でんちぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}できない→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: can't contact because battery is dead
- {電池切|でんちぎ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent battery drain

SIMILAR ～{切|ぎ}れ EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧{切|ぎ}れ: battery dead (katakana variant)
- ⟦{充電|じゅうでん}{切|ぎ}れ→充電切れ：09738_juudengire⟧: out of charge
- ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧{切|ぎ}れ: out of gas
- ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧: out of stock

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧: charging
- ⟦{充電器|じゅうでんき}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧: charger
- ⟦モバイルバッテリー→モバイルバッテリー：07553_mobairubatterii⟧: portable charger/power bank

The ～{切|ぎ}れ pattern (from ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧, to run out) is productive for expressing depletion of any resource.
